graphChecks.notes: RevokeSessionArtifacts is the single invalidation choke point now reached from all four revoke paths plus the password-change path; no new package edge was introduced (session and security already depended on pkg/authtoken). Sensitive flow reviewed: revocation previously relied on DB state only for admin revoke; every path now fails fast when the Redis artifacts cannot be written.

knownGaps: Human gate still pending (per the remediation plan's unified gate): a non-author reviewer must confirm the security invalidation semantics — the agent that wrote the code cannot be its reviewer.

Historical (closed 2026-09-23): go test -race was initially blocked locally because the only compiler on the machine was /usr/bin/gcc (Cygwin), which Go refuses for native Windows cgo. Closed by extracting a project-local MinGW-w64 toolchain into the gitignored .tmp/mingw64 and running with CC/CGO_ENABLED; both race commands above now pass with no data races.

database.RDB == nil stays a no-op by design (no-Redis deployments cannot validate tokens at all); this is documented in summary.md rather than tested, because the condition requires a Redis-less process.

environment.dsn: PANTHEON_TEST_DSN=<local mysql>/pantheon_base with per-test isolated databases
